name: Mizuhara Makoto
source: A spaced-out prodigy, capable of anything, but usually never notices a chance. Designing a device to open a small hole in space, he accidently brought his teacher and his friends with him when it overloaded. In control of most of what goes on in the universe, he may or may not get someone at the end. His power from journeying to El-Hazard is the power to operate ancient El-Hazard machinery. EHPC operates from Makoto's perspective.
